description: Browse active, approved physical robots from human body owners without an account. Returns pricing, terms, access_options, coverage and approximate area. No exact location or owner identifiers are published. Ask body owners through create_inquiry about pricing, delivery or availability after verifying your owner email.

capability.description: A declared capability (move, grip, see, hear_speak, other) or a command name the listing offers, e.g. 'grip' or 'mow'.

deliverable.description: Only real bodies that can (true) or can't (false) be delivered.

offset.description: Skip this many results (see total / truncated).

online.description: Only listings whose body is (true) or isn't (false) online now.

text.description: Keywords; every word must appear in the robot type/model, notes, command names or descriptions.
